The '''Deysum system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
During the [[Nagai–Tof War]], the system was passed by the second movements of the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] invasion forces on their way to [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]]. The system was later invaded and occupied by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] shortly after they arrived in nearby [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA" />
